title: In Praise of Laziness
summary: A painting that grows only while you hold perfectly still, drawn in the browser's confessed idle time.
mechanism: requestIdleCallback paints a stroke as long as deadline.timeRemaining(), but only while the viewer is still: mousemove/scroll/keydown listeners mark the hand as stirring, and paint is withheld until it has lain untouched for 400 ms. Move the mouse and the painting stops; hold still and it resumes.
references: Mladen Stilinovic, In Praise of Laziness (1993)
